evidence.description: Confirmed: only privateKey/createdAt/rotatedAt/rotationReason keys, no 'address' field -- PROP-004/REQ-001's revised methodology (derive via eth_account, never read a nonexistent address field) is now correct and implementable (FIND-001 resolved).

Confirmed ANICCA_HOME=/Users/operator/.anicca, HOME=/Users/operator for automaton -- legacy-fallback branch condition (effectiveHome === HOME/.anicca) is true, matching PROP-004's non-regression claim.

Confirmed ANICCA_HOME=/Users/operator/.blockrun for Franklin; /Users/operator/.blockrun/.automaton/wallet.json read directly confirms privateKey+address matching 0x3EcCAD24... (REQ-001's Franklin AC is implementable).

NEW CRITICAL finding (FIND-006): automaton's own loop has already executed 70 real franklin-trading passes since 2026-07-04 against a wallet hardcoded to ~/.blockrun/ (Franklin's), not automaton's own -- the spec's root-cause section never grounds this, and PROP-012 never tests the missing-wallet HALT branch that must fire to stop it.

NEW finding (FIND-007): ANICCA_SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY is the Solana-side twin of FIND-004's ANICCA_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY override, left completely unaddressed by REQ-002/PROP-011/012 despite REQ-001 fixing the EVM twin this same iteration.

FIND-003 resolved: full re-read confirms no 'fake CLI in $PATH' pattern exists here; verification-architecture.md now correctly cites the ACTUAL env-i PII pattern (lines 30-37) and fake_solana_rpc.mjs pattern (lines 49-67), and honestly labels the PATH-stub as a new technique rather than false precedent.
FIND-005 resolved: REQ-002 now explicitly carries the earn-guard.mjs pass-boundary HALT obligation this line documents, rather than merely citing it.

FIND-006: registry.json's own summary/riskNote asserts sol-trade 'trades the instance's own Solana bankroll' -- contradicted by SKILL.md's hardcoded ~/.blockrun/ wallet path and by the live trace evidence; the spec's grounded-root-causes section does not reconcile this.
FIND-008: existing abort/error-degrade convention (swap/yield branches) is not carried into REQ-002's edge cases for a failed franklin-trading balance read.
FIND-001 resolved: PROP-004 methodology now derives the address from the real privateKey field via eth_account, verified implementable against the real file.

PROP-011 (wallet derivation in isolation) and PROP-013 (ANICCA_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY regression, EVM only) are each individually sound and implementable, but PROP-012's test methodology (negative-net-for-a-KNOWN-wallet only) leaves the missing-wallet/empty-address integration path (FIND-006) and the Solana override path (FIND-007, no PROP-013 twin) unverified.

FIND-001.note: PROP-004 and REQ-001's AC now require deriving the address from the real privateKey field via eth_account/viem, explicitly forbidding reading a nonexistent 'address' field. Verified against the real file: /Users/operator/.automaton/wallet.json's only keys are privateKey/createdAt/rotatedAt/rotationReason -- the revised methodology is implementable, the old one was not.

FIND-002.note: REQ-002/PROP-011 now mandate deriving sol-trade's ledger-recorded wallet address via runtime/wallet-address-solana.mjs (ANICCA_HOME-gated), never hardcoded. Confirmed unmodified/correct at runtime/wallet-address-solana.mjs and resolve-identity.mjs::resolveSolanaSecret. NOTE: this only fixes the LEDGER-BOOKKEEPING wallet field -- see FIND-006 for the separate, unaddressed issue of the underlying franklin-trading CLI's own execution wallet.

FIND-003.note: verification-architecture.md now explicitly states the old 'fake CLI in $PATH' precedent does not exist in skills/earn/clip-promote/tests/test_run.sh (confirmed by direct re-read) and replaces it with the ACTUAL proven env-i PII-isolation pattern (test_run.sh:30-37) and fake_solana_rpc.mjs local-HTTP-RPC-stub pattern (test_run.sh:49-67, fake_solana_rpc.mjs confirmed to exist and match the described shape), honestly labeling the new PATH-stub technique as new rather than precedented.

FIND-004.note: REQ-001 now has an explicit edge case for ANICCA_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY (resolve-identity.mjs:63-67, confirmed as the actual highest-priority override), a defensive `unset` requirement in earn/run.sh, and PROP-013 with a concrete bash-fixture test methodology. Resolved for the EVM path. NOTE: the identical contamination class is left open on the Solana path this same iteration introduces -- see FIND-007 (new).

FIND-005.note: REQ-002 now explicitly requires sol-trade/run.sh to call earn-guard.mjs's cumulative fail-closed HALT check at its own pass boundary (PROP-012), mirroring earn/run.sh:78 and economy/gig/run.sh:62-65, directly satisfying skills/earn/SKILL.md:80-82's documented convention rather than merely citing it.
